parts.gloss: to consume or be smeared with kohl

words.gloss: to the one who united with me

literal: If my fish-like, kohl-smeared eyes, when I beg them, would sleep, I would tell the reality of my survival to the one who united with me in my dreams, alas.
translation: If only my fish-like, kohl-painted eyes would sleep when I beg them to, I could tell my lover, who unites with me in my dreams, the painful reality of how I survive this separation.
modern: மீன் போன்ற மை தீட்டிய என் கண்கள் நான் கெஞ்சி கேட்கும்போது தூங்குமானால், என் கனவில் வந்து என்னோடு கலந்த காதலருக்கு நான் உயிர் பிழைத்திருக்கும் உண்மையைச் சொல்வேன்; ஆனால் அவை தூங்குவதில்லையே!
explanation: The heroine is suffering from the intense pain of separation and can only meet her lover in her dreams. However, her beautiful, fish-like eyes (கயலுண்கண்) refuse to close and sleep, even when she begs them (யான் இரப்ப) to do so. She laments that if they would only sleep (துஞ்சின்), she could see her lover in her dreams and tell him (சாற்றுவேன்) the painful truth of how she barely manages to survive (உயல் உண்மை) without him. The particle 'மன்' at the end emphasizes her regret, indicating that her eyes remain stubbornly awake, denying her even the solace of a dream.
